name: DIN A6 media to labelled filing lane

coordinate_frame.origin: front-left inner corner of the divider set floor
coordinate_frame.x_positive: along the lane width, across the A6 105 mm short edge

datums.description: lane side wall pair defining the clear width

allowed: vertical insertion and withdrawal of one or more cards
constrained: cards bending against a wall on insertion

assembly.sequence_notes: Top and one long side stay fully open for finger access.

dimensions.feature: lane clear width = 105 mm plus process clearance

keepouts_and_access: No archival, acid-free, moisture, UV, fire or privacy-protection claim.
Keep the top and one long side open.

evidence.uncertainty_note: The calibration registry returns NO_MATCHING_PROCESS for Anycubic Kobra 3 Max / SUNLU PETG / 0.4 mm: xy_clearance_sliding and hole_delta_vertical are UNQUALIFIED. The interface nominal is published and exact, but the clearance that realises the fit must come from a coupon on this exact process and must not be assumed.

failure_modes.mode: Lane is too narrow and the card buckles on insertion.
failure_modes.effect: Damaged media and a poor filing experience.
failure_modes.mitigation: Qualify xy_clearance_sliding by coupon before committing the lane width.

failure_modes.mode: Lane is too wide and cards lean or slip between lanes.
failure_modes.mitigation: Coupon the minus/nominal/plus series and select the tightest free-running fit.

acceptance_criteria: The lane coupon holds 105 mm plus the qualified clearance within 0.30 mm.
A card enters and leaves single-handed without snagging or bending.
100 filing cycles leave no scuff on the media.
